summary: The MaintDestination module manages various aspects of destinations within the HSPnet system. It offers functionalities for managing destination contacts, viewing and editing details, and handling user permissions related to destination management.
purpose: This module is designed to facilitate the management of destination data, including viewing, editing, and maintaining contacts, and ensuring compliance with data standards and user permissions for system administrators and local administrators.
